newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Biota starts 'flu drug trial in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Biota starts 'flu drug trial in Australia.

text.p: Drug research company, Biota Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had commenced final testing of its anti-influenza drug, GG167 in Australia today.

The company said the testing would continue in Australia throughout the winter in New South Wales, Victoria, South Australia and Queensland before being undertaken in Europe through the northern hemisphere winter.
"The phase III trials are expected to be completed next year. Success in these trials will lead to registration for approval to the market throughout the world," the company said in a statement.
